title: FlashAttention: Fast and Memory-Efficient Exact Attention with IO-Awareness
authors: T. Dao, D. Fu, S. Ermon, A. Rudra, C. Ré
before: Long context was attacked by approximating attention with sparse patterns.
problem: Attention was slow because of memory traffic between GPU levels, not because of arithmetic.
breakthrough: Tile the computation so it stays in fast on-chip memory and never writes the full attention matrix. Exact, not approximate.
why: It made long context an engineering problem rather than an architectural compromise, and most approximations became unnecessary.
next: FlashAttention-2 and 3, vLLM's serving stack, and the long-context race.
inherits: The kernel your model is almost certainly using right now.
